signal_selected_consumer.profile: Pinned unprivileged native container, uid/gid 1000, CPUs 2-5, 12 GiB with no additional swap, 512 tasks, no network/capabilities, read-only repository and private writable /work.
covered: Two sequential selected native sigreturn alternate-stack round trips clear SS_ONSTACK.
Nested selected return preserves active state until the outer return clears it.
Restored RSP/RIP and complete alternate-stack base/size/flags are asserted.
Copy and FP callback failures preserve context fields, signal mask and alternate-stack state.
preserved_review_corrections: Use one raw register-context pointer throughout to avoid conflicting reference provenance.
Use a distinct valid saved alternate-stack configuration so premature failure-path restoration is observable.
signal_selected_consumer.limitations: Synthetic frame storage and controlled callbacks; no real restorer copy, architectural FP restore, syscall-dispatch execution or c81 signal guest result.

covered: Phase-specific CPU inventories derive from a separately hash-bound trusted baseline/offline authorization input.
Transient boot/workload/pre-stop inventories equal baseline minus authorized offline CPUs.
Release, unload and policy-restored boundaries exactly restore the baseline.
Joint observation/embedded-expectation mutation cannot override the separate anchor.
Trusted input opens no-follow and nonblocking, then rejects non-regular FIFO and symlink inputs.
preserved_failures: The initial candidate allowed jointly changing observations and in-document CPU expectations.
The first trusted reader could block indefinitely opening a FIFO before fstat.
The initial corrected-test construction failure remains at /tmp/native-shutdown-observer-tests-20261001-2.stdout.
shutdown_observer.limitations: Source/protocol evidence only. Future collector and execution packet must independently pin the CPU expectation digest. Actual booted shutdown still returns ENOSYS and STOP/drain/reset/resource retirement remain open.
